subcategory_text: Data are processed to limit the formulation of inferences about individuals’ behavior or activities (e.g., data processing is decentralized, distributed architectures).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-7 (Boundary Protection), AC-4 (Information Flow Enforcement)
Aligned with NIST AI RMF MANAGE 4.1 (AI risks identified)
implementation_examples: Process data in decentralised or distributed architectures to limit the formulation of inferences about individuals' behaviour or activities
Document the architectural split and the privacy properties it provides
Use centralised monitoring only where the privacy properties are preserved
assessment_objectives: Determine whether processing architectures limit inference aggregation
Determine whether the architectural split is documented
Determine whether centralised monitoring preserves the privacy properties
Determine whether the architecture is tested for inference leakage
